text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury slipped to 55.99 percent from 56.88 percent at the last sale on November 21, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue
of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 29.389 million UAH 84.786 million UAH
Actual amount raised 25.789 million UAH 74.254 million UAH Average yield 55.99 pct 56.88 pct
The central bank sold 293,899 T-bills, the bank's statement
said. Of those, 250,192 were competitive and 43,707 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 28.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills edged down to 58.99 percent from 59.90 percent at the last sale on November 21, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 9.636 million UAH 36.837 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.446 million UAH 28.365 million UAH
The central bank sold 96,361 T-bills, the bank's statement said.Of those, 82,639 were competitive and 13,722 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 28.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills rose to 58.51 percent from 58.45 percent at the last sale on November 21, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 2,486 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 1,020 were competitive and 1,466 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 28.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills rose to 60.96 percent from 60.94 percent at the last sale on November 19, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 693 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 650 were competitive and 43 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 28.
